exam.title: Mathematics Paper 1 (13/1) - October/November 2024
exam.subject: Mathematics
exam.description: Botswana Examinations Council, Junior Certificate Examination. Answer all 40 questions. Four possible answers are given for each; choose the one you think is correct. The use of any calculating aid is not allowed for this paper.

questions.question: What is the order of rotational symmetry of the shape given below?
What is the value of [3, -1] + [-7, -5]? (column vectors)

Libho is employed by an advertising company to deliver leaflets. He is paid a basic monthly salary of P2 100 plus commission of P25 per 100 leaflets delivered. In one month Libho delivered 3 300 leaflets. What is his total earnings for the month?
When shape T is reflected through line R, it forms an image of shape S. Which diagram below shows the reflection of shape T to shape S?
The first five terms of a sequence are -18, -25, -32, -39 and -46. What is the rule, in terms of n, for the nth term of the sequence?
Which of the following is the net of a triangular prism?

The table below shows departure times and expected arrival times of buses from Jwaneng to Gaborone and from Gaborone to Orapa. Prince wants to go to Orapa from Jwaneng via Gaborone. He arrives at the Jwaneng bus rank at 0645 and catches the next bus to Gaborone. What is the earliest time he is expected to arrive in Orapa?
Using the same bus timetable, what is the expected length of time of the journey for the bus which leaves Gaborone to Orapa at 11 30?
What is (7m - 42)/14 when expressed in simplified form?

A teacher asks Grace two questions. Grace answers each question with a Yes (Y), No (N) or Undecided (U). The probability space diagram shows the possible joint outcomes of answering the two questions, all equally likely. What is the probability that Grace will answer both questions with a 'No'?
The table below shows the order in which four students evaluated the expression (a x b)/(v x w) after substituting for the values of a, b, v and w. Which student used the correct order?

The cost of diesel is P17.94 per litre. Kaone puts 23.9 litres of diesel in her car and the pump machine shows the total cost of the diesel as P428.77. How much, to the nearest 5 thebe, is Kaone expected to pay?
A square has a perimeter of 22 cm. What is the area of the square?
What is the value of 5(H - 36)/9 when H is -63?
The lengths of the three sides of a right-angled triangle are in the ratio 8 : 15 : 17. What is the tangent ratio of the smallest angle?
The diagram below represents a coin which is in the form of a regular nonagon ABCDEFGHI with centre O. What is the size of angle OEF?
What is h when expressed in terms of b and x in the formula 3h = 4x + 2bh?

The annual cost of renewing a motor vehicle license consists of a general levy of P50 and a vehicle license fee, which depends on the un-laden weight of the vehicle (see table). Percy renews motor vehicle licenses of two cars whose weights are 1 121 Kg and 1 765 Kg. What is the total cost of renewing the motor vehicle licenses for the two cars?
What is 2a² - a - 6 when factorized completely?
What is x + (3 - 2x)/3 when expressed as a single fraction?
Solve the equation 4x/9 + 4 = -2.
Pages 24 and 43 are on the same double sheet of a magazine. What is the page number that is on the same double sheet with page 16?
Given that 360 = 2³ x 3² x 5, what is 360⁴ when expressed as a product of its prime factors?
The wheel of a bicycle has a diameter of 67.2 cm. What is the circumference of the wheel of the bicycle? Take π as 22/7.

The pie chart below shows information on the number of students in different departments of a university. There are 180 students in the Health department. How many students are there in the university altogether?

Square tiles each of length 40 mm are used to make a rectangular mosaic tile. The length of the mosaic tile is 240 mm and its width is 200 mm. How many square tiles are needed to make the rectangular mosaic tile?
Each square tile has a thickness of 8 mm. What is the volume of one square tile?
The point (-2, 2) is the midpoint of a line segment joining the points P(3, 9) and Q. What are the coordinates of point Q?
What is the length of the side labelled t on the diagram below? (right-angled triangle, legs 16 cm and 12 cm)

The monthly rental of an office space depends on its floor area. An office whose floor area has a length of 5 m has a monthly rental of P2 000. What is the monthly rental of a similar office whose floor area has a length of 6 m?
The gradient of a line joining the points (3a, 3) and (a, -2) is 3. What is the value of a?
Solve the simultaneous equations 8x + y = -16 and -3x + y = -5.
What is (7x + 2y)(7x - 2y)?
What is 20 m/s when expressed in km/h?

The diagram below shows the speed-time graph of a moving particle which attained a maximum speed of V. The total distance covered by the moving particle is 900 m. What is V, the maximum speed attained by the particle?
The diagram below shows the positions of two tuckshops, Ganto (G) and Henills (H), such that the bearing of Henills from Ganto is 041°. What is the bearing of Ganto from Henills?
The diagram below represents a vertical flagpole, TP, with supporters fixed at points C and D on level ground. What is the angle of depression of the point D from the top of the flagpole P?
Study the pattern of numbers below: 3*1*3 = 6, 8*5*3 = 9, 7*3*3 = 12. What is the value of 18*5*3?
The cumulative frequency curve below shows the waist measurements, in cm, of 100 people who started a training program. What is the estimate of the median waist measurement?
Using the same cumulative frequency curve, all those whose waist measurements were 65 cm or less were referred to a dietician. How many people were referred to a dietician?
